# opnsense_acmeclient_validation (Resource)

ACME challenge types (**Services ▸ ACME Client ▸ Challenge Types**, plugin `os-acme-client`): HTTP-01, TLS-ALPN-01 or DNS-01 with one of the acme.sh DNS providers. Only the attributes of the chosen `dns_service` are used.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_acmeclient_validation" "cloudflare" {
  name         = "cloudflare"
  method       = "dns01"
  dns_service  = "dns_cf"
  dns_cf_token = var.cloudflare_token
}
```

- `dns_sl_project_name` (String) Project name. Defaults to ``.
- `dns_sl_token_lifetime` (String, Sensitive) Token lifetime in minutes (0-1440). Defaults to ``.
- `dns_sleep` (Number) The time in seconds to wait for all the TXT records to take effect after adding them to the DNS API. Defaults to 0 seconds, which causes Acme Client to check public DNS services every 10 seconds for up to 20 minutes. If set to a non-zero value, a fixed DNS sleep time will be used and the local DNS servers will be queried instead. A DNS sleep time of 120 seconds or more is recommended for some DNS APIs. Defaults to `0`.
- `dns_spaceship_api_key` (String, Sensitive) API Key. Defaults to ``.
- `dns_spaceship_api_secret` (String, Sensitive) API Secret. Defaults to ``.

- `dns_technitium_token` (String, Sensitive) Generate a token from Technitium user and grant rights to the necessary zones. Defaults to ``.

- `dns_uno_user` (String) User. Defaults to ``.

- `dns_vultr_key` (String, Sensitive) Key. Defaults to ``.
- `dns_websupport_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Identifier. Defaults to ``.
- `dns_websupport_api_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret key. Defaults to ``.

Set the protocol to JSON and add the public IP addresses of this OPNsense instance to the allowed IP addresses. Note that requests from any other IP are rejected, so whitelist the address the server actually uses for outgoing connections — on dual-stack OPNsense this is usually the IPv6 address. Defaults to ``.

- `dns_zoneedit_token` (String, Sensitive) ZoneEdit Token. Defaults to ``.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this validation. Defaults to `true`.
- `http_haproxy_frontends` (Set of String) Choose the local HAProxy frontends. They will automatically be configured to redirect acme challenges to the internal acme client. The HAProxy service will automatically be restarted if a certificate was renewed. Defaults to `[]`.
- `http_haproxy_inject` (Boolean) Automatically inject config into the local HAProxy instance to let it serve acme challanges without service interruption. Of course, adding the configuration requires a short restart of the HAProxy service. Defaults to `true`.
- `http_opn_autodiscovery` (Boolean) The FQDN's used in your certificate must currently point to an official IP address. Choose this option to let OPNsense try to auto-discover these IP addresses. This will lead to a short downtime of the service that is normally used with this IP address.NOTE:This will ONLY work if the official IP addresses are LOCALLY configured on your OPNsense firewall. Defaults to `true`.
- `http_opn_interface` (String) The FQDN's used in your certificate must currently point to an official IP address. Choose the interface where this IP address is currently configured. OPNsense will automatically create a temporary port forward to allow the ACME validation to succeed. This will lead to a short downtime of the service that is normally used with this IP address.NOTE:This will ONLY work if the official IP addresses are LOCALLY configured on your OPNsense firewall. Defaults to ``.
- `http_opn_ipaddresses` (Set of String) The FQDN's used in your certificate must currently point to one or more official IP addresses. Enter the all of these IP addresses here. OPNsense will automatically create a temporary port forward to allow the ACME validation to succeed. This will lead to a short downtime of the service that is normally used with these IP addresses.NOTE:This will ONLY work if the official IP addresses are LOCALLY configured on your OPNsense firewall. Defaults to `[]`.
- `http_service` (String) HTTP Service. One of `opnsense`, `haproxy`. Defaults to `opnsense`.
- `method` (String) Set the ACME challenge type. You'll have to add configuration for the selected challenge type below. One of `http01`, `dns01`, `tlsalpn01`. Defaults to `dns01`.
- `tlsalpn_acme_autodiscovery` (Boolean) The FQDN's used in your certificate must currently point to an official IP address. Choose this option to let OPNsense try to auto-discover these IP addresses. This will lead to a short downtime of the service that is normally used with this IP address.NOTE:This will ONLY work if the official IP addresses are LOCALLY configured on your OPNsense firewall. Defaults to `true`.
- `tlsalpn_acme_interface` (String) The FQDN's used in your certificate must currently point to an official IP address. Choose the interface where this IP address is currently configured. OPNsense will automatically create a temporary port forward to allow the ACME validation to succeed. This will lead to a short downtime of the service that is normally used with this IP address.NOTE:This will ONLY work if the official IP addresses are LOCALLY configured on your OPNsense firewall. Defaults to ``.
- `tlsalpn_acme_ipaddresses` (Set of String) The FQDN's used in your certificate must currently point to one or more official IP addresses. Enter the all of these IP addresses here. OPNsense will automatically create a temporary port forward to allow the ACME validation to succeed. This will lead to a short downtime of the service that is normally used with these IP addresses.NOTE:This will ONLY work if the official IP addresses are LOCALLY configured on your OPNsense firewall. Defaults to `[]`.
- `tlsalpn_service` (String) TLS-ALPN Service. One of `acme`. Defaults to `acme`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the ACME challenge type.
